problem: Find the real part of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} & 7-6\text{i} \\ -\text{i} & 4\end{aligned}].$

feedback.problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}e & f \\ g & h\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}-3-9\text{i} & -7+\text{i} \\ -5-2\text{i} & -4\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $bc-ef?$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-3-9\text{i} & -7+\text{i} \\ -5-2\text{i} & -4\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\ A & =[\begin{aligned}-3-9\text{i} & -7+\text{i} \\ -5-2\text{i} & 0-4\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}-3 & -7 \\ -5 & 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}-9 & 1 \\ -2 & -4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

So we have $b=-7,c=-5,e=-9$ and $f=1.$ Therefore,

$$
bc-ef=(-7)\cdot (-5)-(-9)\cdot 1=44.
$$
